help.subtitle: Everything you need to get started with app2nix
help.how_desc: app2nix automatically converts any Linux package into a NixOS-compatible expression:
help.step1_desc: Click 'Browse' to select a Linux package file (.deb, .rpm, .AppImage, .flatpak, .snap, .tar.gz, .zip).
help.step2_desc: Click 'Analyze' to detect the format, extract dependencies, and generate a NixOS expression automatically.
help.step3_desc: Review the generated Nix expression. Edit it directly, then save as default.nix or flake.nix.
help.step4_desc: Click 'Install on NixOS' to build and install, or use the saved .nix file with nix profile install.
help.formats_desc: app2nix supports the following package formats with automatic detection and extraction:
help.cli_convert_desc: Analyze a .deb and generate a default.nix file
help.cli_batch_desc: Convert all packages in a directory in parallel
help.cli_install_manual_desc: Install a built package into your user profile
help.cli_install_nixos_desc: Rebuild system config with the new package
help.cli_server_desc: Launch the web UI on port 8000
help.faq1_a: app2nix converts Linux packages (.deb, .rpm, .AppImage, etc.) into NixOS expressions, allowing you to install any Linux package on NixOS. It analyzes dependencies, maps them to Nix packages, and generates ready-to-use Nix expressions.
help.faq2_q: Why do I get 'webkitgtk_4_0 has been removed'?
help.faq2_a: This means the package depends on an old WebKit version removed from nixpkgs. app2nix automatically maps webkitgtk_4_0 to webkitgtk_4_1. If it still fails, the upstream developer may need to update.
help.faq3_q: How do I install a .deb package?
help.faq3_a: Browse for the .deb file, click Analyze, review the generated Nix expression, and click Install. app2nix handles dpkg extraction automatically.
help.faq4_a: Yes! Check 'System install (sudo)' before clicking Install. You'll be prompted for your sudo password.
help.faq5_q: What if a dependency can't be resolved?
help.faq5_a: Some uncommon libraries may not have a NixOS equivalent. Find the Nix package name at search.nixos.org and add it to the generated expression.
help.faq6_a: app2nix tries --appimage-extract (FUSE) first. On failure, it falls back to unsquashfs. On NixOS, squashfs-tools is auto-installed via nix-shell.
help.faq7_q: I get 'profile is incompatible with nix-env'. What now?
help.faq7_a: Your Nix profile was created with 'nix profile' commands. Use 'nix profile install' instead of 'nix-env -i'. app2nix uses nix-build + nix profile install by default.
help.faq8_q: How do I uninstall a package installed by app2nix?
help.faq8_a: Run 'nix profile remove <package-name>' to remove the package. .desktop files are cleaned up automatically on next install.
help.tip1_desc: If you get a sandbox error, your root directory may be world-writable. Fix with: sudo chmod 755 /
help.tip2_desc: app2nix automatically sets NIXPKGS_ALLOW_UNFREE=1 during installation.
help.tip3_desc: After installation, app2nix automatically installs .desktop files and icons so the app appears in your menu.
help.tip4_desc: Use --parallel N with the CLI to convert packages in parallel. Enable Nix substituters for faster downloads.
help.tip5_desc: List: 'nix profile list'. Remove: 'nix profile remove <name>'. Diff: 'nix profile diff-closures'.
